first_self_test_incident.cause: The static scan searched the entire source file, including the self-test strings that named the forbidden fields, so the test detected its own assertions rather than alpha usage.
first_self_test_incident.fix: Restrict the static scan to evaluator implementation text before def self_test().

validated_properties: event is exact P<=MA20/P>MA50 to D>MA20/D>MA50 transition
P is exact previous joint trading session and cannot skip a missing/suspended bar
D+1-or-later state cannot alter the D event
same-security event starts are suppressed from D through fixed D+10 inclusive
intact-trend non-reclaim controls exclude accepted reclaim events
fold aggregation is equal-weight by signal date
compression features are not used as alpha
liquidity features are not used as alpha
ret_20 and ret_60 are not used as entry filters
natural zero boundaries are used for MA20 and MA50
real AC outcome research was not executed during validation

provider_neutral_tradability_note.policy: If a frozen source exposes tradestatus, require tradestatus=1. If the provider snapshot has no tradestatus field, exact joint-date source-bar existence is used as the provider-native tradability evidence; no row is backfilled or skipped.
